title: add release manifests, cosign signing, SBOM provenance, and CI automation for private-installer
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Enable end-to-end release automation for private-installer artifacts (helm charts, terraform modules, and installer bundles) with verifiable provenance. This PR adds build-time SBOM generation, Cosign signing, release manifest generation, and a CI workflow to publish signed manifests to the artifacts bucket.

What this changes: 1) CI workflows: add .github/workflows/release-manifests.yml to build artifacts, produce SBOMs via syft, upload provenance and signatures via cosign, and generate release-manifests.json for downstream consumers. 2) Packaging: add scripts/packaging/make-release-bundle.sh to assemble installer tarballs and k8s manifests. 3) Helm/Terraform: small chart bump and metadata annotations (Chart.yaml, terraform/modules/private-installer/metadata.tf) to include image digests and SBOM links. 4) Verification: CI includes a verify-signatures job that demonstrates cosign verification of published artifacts.

Checklist: - [x] Build pipeline for release artifacts - [x] SBOM generation (syft) - [x] Cosign signing + key reference via KMS (docs updated) - [x] Release manifest schema and example - [x] Downstream verification job - [x] Release notes draft

Notes: Keys are consumed from the release CI KMS role; demo keys used in staging. This PR intentionally keeps signing integration behind a feature flag (RELEASE_SIGNING=true) so we can roll out to staging before enabling production keys. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and security review.
commits: Add SBOM generation step using syft and attach SBOMs to artifacts
Integrate cosign signing + verification step (uses KMS keyref in CI)
Bump helm chart metadata and terraform module annotations to include provenance links
Update docs/RELEASES.md with signing/provenance notes and verification instructions
review_comments: Miguel Torres: Can you split the generate-manifest.go into a smaller helper? It's fine for this PR but we should avoid large single-file logic.
Asha Patel: split generate-manifest.go into two functions and added unit tests for manifest validation (follow-up commit)
Kai Nguyen: Please add an example of how downstream consumers should verify the signature and SBOM. Added docs/RELEASES.md updates in this PR.
Elena Fischer: Security review: the CI key usage pattern looks good; ensure the KMS key is present in the release account before enabling production flag. Approved after docs update.
release_notes: Adds CI automation for signed release manifests for private-installer: SBOM generation (syft), cosign signing, release-manifests.json generation, and verification job. Feature gated by RELEASE_SIGNING flag. See docs/RELEASES.md for verification steps.
additional_context: This PR is the second phase of the supply-chain hardening work; follow-up will wire production KMS keys and migrate existing artifacts to the signed manifest pipeline.
Staging rollout: ENABLE_RELEASE_SIGNING=true on staging CI for one week, then enable on prod with monitoring alerts to detect verification failures.
Downstream consumers (private deployment installer, helm charts, terraform) should read build/release-manifests/schema.json to locate signed artifact URLs and SBOMs.
